outcome: Developmental status (Ages and Stages Questionnaire score, gross movement, fine movement)
cohort: The study included 214 one-year-old infants from Isfahan health centers, divided into baby walker user and non-user groups.
finding: Baby walker usage was not significantly associated with differences in gross movement or fine movement development at 12 and 18 months of age.
mod_finding: Baby walker usage was not significantly associated with the infant's delivery method.
